Sentence (English): My old 2012 Kitchen Aid DW electronics panel died.
Comments (English): [ Replacement Dishwsher is an upgrade. ] || ---------------- || My old 2012 Kitchen Aid DW electronics panel died. Twas cheaper to buy a new one. Walked into the showroom (yes they still have those) to see things up close and personal after exhaustive online searching. Most of those review sites are bought and paid for, so I have trust issues. The KitchenAid was there for inspection.I liked the improvements over my old one -- new rack design, third (top) shelf, progress light on door, reorganized cleaning options. Checked Costco's price, they beat it and installed it the next day. Never missed a load. This machine is a quiet one, more so that my quiet old guy. Cleans great. No real negatives except new shelf design takes getting used to loading, utensil rack has individual slots. Reviews criticize drying abilities. Its doing okay except top rack needs wipe off. All in all I am satisfied and believe it's an upgrade over a similar 2012 model. Let's see if it holds up as well as the old guy did.

So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved and it is quiet even when turned on at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, I wanted to buy a 12-person built-in dishwasher if I had more space. It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved and it is quiet even when turned on at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, I wanted to buy a 12-person built-in dishwasher if I had more space. It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved and it is quiet even when turned on at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, I wanted to buy a 12-person built-in dishwasher if I had more space. It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. When I get off work, eat dinner, and clean up, it's sometimes 10 or 11 at night, but when I put it back on and go into the bedroom, I don't really care about the sound of the dishwasher. It makes a gurgling sound because the water drains, but it's much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it's satisfying that it finishes drying for more than half a day, and it's also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, there will still be moisture in the concave part or in the place where water can collect even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish when you put it in. The installer was also kind and carefully arranged the location for my kitchen, and he also told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Additional I splashed some kimchi while cutting it, but I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue and it was clean. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse and only use detergent, and although there are some white water stains, it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There's no major problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It's very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior Easy to install and the technician was kind Satisfied with both the cleaning power and the drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher in an environment with limited kitchen space or where built-in installation is difficult. It's the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

Comments (English): [ Quality of life skyrockets. It is quiet even when running at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, if I had the space, I wanted to buy a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Comments (English): [ Quality of life skyrockets. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Comments (English): [ Quality of life skyrockets. It is quiet even when running at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, if I had the space, I wanted to buy a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

It is quiet even when running at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, if I had the space, I wanted to buy a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Sentence (English): I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult.
Comments (English): [ Quality of life skyrockets. It is quiet even when running at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, if I had the space, I wanted to buy a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Sentence (English): It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!
Comments (English): [ Quality of life skyrockets. It is quiet even when running at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, if I had the space, I wanted to buy a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher. It’s just too exhausting to cook and do the dishes after getting home from work. Large-capacity built-in models were very appealing, but unfortunately, due to the layout of my kitchen, there was simply no room to fit one that size. So, after much deliberation, I chose this Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, at first, I was worried if a 6-place setting would be sufficient, but after actually using it, I am satisfied because it can easily handle the amount of dishes for one or two meals for a family of two. Needless to say, the design is impeccable; the white color is clean and luxurious, brightening up the kitchen atmosphere. Thanks to Bespoke’s signature minimalist and sophisticated design, it fits perfectly with the interior decor. It is a bit larger than I expected, but as long as you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any trouble. Best of all, the noise level during washing is incredibly low. I can run it without worry even on nights when I eat late, and not having to be bothered by noise has significantly reduced my stress. Saving water and cleaning much more thoroughly than hand washing is a given. Sometimes it’s 10 or 11 PM when I get home from work, eat dinner, and clean up, but once I start it and go into the bedroom, I barely notice the sound of the dishwasher running. There is a gurgling sound as the water drains, but it is much quieter than a washer-dryer. The drying function is also good; although some moisture remains, I am satisfied that it finishes feeling as if it has been dried for over half a day. It is also useful that there are various washing modes to choose from depending on the situation. However, water remains in the concave parts or areas where water might pool when dishes are turned upside down even after the wash is finished. It might be easier to load the dishes at an angle. The installation technician was also kind; he carefully positioned the dishwasher to fit the kitchen, taught me how to check for leaks later, and explained the machine well, so I had a good experience right from the start of the installation. Added 6/14: Some kimchi splattered while I was chopping it, but I wiped it off quickly with a wet tissue and it came off cleanly. Added 7/8. I don't use rinse aid and only use detergent. Although slight white water stains do appear, it isn't a major issue, so I'm just using it as is. There are no significant problems with the cleaning power. 8/23 Update: When running it with only lightweight plastic dishes, the plates sometimes stand upright and water pools. I think you need to press down on very light dishes to hold them in place. . Overall Review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough for washing one or two meals). Very quiet, so it can be used comfortably even at night. The Bespoke White design is luxurious and blends well with kitchen decor. Installation was easy, and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power! My quality of life has improved dramatically since I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore. . I highly recommend this to anyone with limited kitchen space or those considering a dishwasher in environments where built-in installation is difficult. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a beautiful kitchen and convenient dishwashing!

Sentence (English): I purchased a Bosch 800 dishwasher, installation services and installation parts when I ordered.
Comments (English): [ Poor Delivery & Service ] || ---------------- || I purchased a Bosch 800 dishwasher, installation services and installation parts when I ordered. The delivery crew did not bring the Bosch hardwiring junction box that was part of the order and could not complete the installation. They left the new dishwasher sitting in the middle of my kitchen. I showed the delivery driver the order that had the junction box listed on it and he said he didn't have it and acted like it wasn't his responsibility to bring. Afterwards I called Home Deport Customer Service and was initially told I needed to have a plumber come out and install the electrical box. I was then put on hold for a couple of minutes and when the attendant came back on told me that they were trying to get the same delivery team to bring the junction box to me that evening. Later I got a voicemail telling me the delivery team couldn't make it back that evening but someone else would come out 2 days later. This is unacceptable. Not only did someone screw up and not bring all of the required parts but then more than 1 person either lied or told me the wrong thing to cover up the mistake. I will install this myself and request a refund for the portion not completed. I may be done with Home Depot going forward.

Sentence (English): You most likely will not receive free installation with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ MUST READ before you order this Bosch dishwasher!  ] || ---------------- || You most likely will not receive free installation with this dishwasher. Be prepared to install yourself or pay handsomely for the installation. I will offer extensive details about my experience with this dishwasher delivery and installation. If you are installing this dishwasher in a new construction project and the kitchen countertops are not installed then it will be a simple installation. If this dishwasher is replacing an already installed dishwasher be prepared for endless issues with your installation. First, most dishwashers are hard wired to the electrical circuit with a dedicated breaker in your main breaker box. The Bosch dishwasher needs a standard electrical outlet so if you do not have an electrical outlet behind your current dishwasher then you will need to install an electrical outlet. Next, Bosch placed a large electrically actuated water safety device on the end of the water supply line. If you cabinetry has a standard 2 inch hole in the wall of the cabinets for the dishwasher water supply line and water drain line you will need to enlarge those holes. The water safety device Bosch stuck on the end of the water supply line is over 3 inches wide. (See included pics) Next, if your dishwasher is located right next to your sink then the attached hoses may be long enough. If there is a cabinet between your dishwasher and sink then you will be purchasing extension hoses for the water drain line and the water supply line. The installed hoses that come attached to the dishwasher from the factory are fairly short. The water supply line on the unit has a large connection end on the water safety device that requires an adapter. My kitchen has a cabinet between the dishwasher and sink so I had to add an additional 3/8 braided water line to the existing installed water line with a connector between the two lines. Then that water line connects under the sink to the water supply. That means there are 4 connections in the water supply where a leak could happen due to the way Bosch has the water supply line connected inside the machine. I will come back at some point and post a review of how the dishwasher performs. Before you purchase this dishwasher from Costco you need to go to a retailer that sells and stocks Bosch dishwashers and look at the connections on the back of the dishwasher and think carefully about your install. As for the delivery and install service, they should receive a NEGATIVE 5 stars. My dishwasher was delivered in the back of a pickup truck on a day with rain and thunderstorms. The dishwasher was wet, the cardboard packaging around the dishwasher was wet, the Styrofoam packaging material was full of rain water in all the crevices and pockets. Instead of using an enclosed box truck for delivery during rain storms, they used an open bed pickup truck. Costco does a good job of selling and delivering some appliances but I would suggest you choose another retailer for dishwashers.

If you are installing this dishwasher in a new construction project and the kitchen countertops are not installed then it will be a simple installation. If this dishwasher is replacing an already installed dishwasher be prepared for endless issues with your installation. First, most dishwashers are hard wired to the electrical circuit with a dedicated breaker in your main breaker box. The Bosch dishwasher needs a standard electrical outlet so if you do not have an electrical outlet behind your current dishwasher then you will need to install an electrical outlet. Next, Bosch placed a large electrically actuated water safety device on the end of the water supply line. If you cabinetry has a standard 2 inch hole in the wall of the cabinets for the dishwasher water supply line and water drain line you will need to enlarge those holes. The water safety device Bosch stuck on the end of the water supply line is over 3 inches wide. (See included pics) Next, if your dishwasher is located right next to your sink then the attached hoses may be long enough. If there is a cabinet between your dishwasher and sink then you will be purchasing extension hoses for the water drain line and the water supply line. The installed hoses that come attached to the dishwasher from the factory are fairly short. The water supply line on the unit has a large connection end on the water safety device that requires an adapter. My kitchen has a cabinet between the dishwasher and sink so I had to add an additional 3/8 braided water line to the existing installed water line with a connector between the two lines. Then that water line connects under the sink to the water supply. That means there are 4 connections in the water supply where a leak could happen due to the way Bosch has the water supply line connected inside the machine. I will come back at some point and post a review of how the dishwasher performs. Before you purchase this dishwasher from Costco you need to go to a retailer that sells and stocks Bosch dishwashers and look at the connections on the back of the dishwasher and think carefully about your install. As for the delivery and install service, they should receive a NEGATIVE 5 stars. My dishwasher was delivered in the back of a pickup truck on a day with rain and thunderstorms. The dishwasher was wet, the cardboard packaging around the dishwasher was wet, the Styrofoam packaging material was full of rain water in all the crevices and pockets. Instead of using an enclosed box truck for delivery during rain storms, they used an open bed pickup truck. Costco does a good job of selling and delivering some appliances but I would suggest you choose another retailer for dishwashers.

I bought it because it was said to solve the headache of washing dishes, but it dried without being washed properly, so the stains were coated, and it was harder to wash the dishes by hand afterwards. -------------------------------- Added content Coupang and the after-sales service technician both kept pushing back and said that refunds were not possible. Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and I bought it because it was a good opportunity. Thank you so much. I will use it for a week and write a review. Delivery It was delivered by rocket delivery and installation, so the installer brought it in person. It arrived without any damage. Installation My house does not use a water purifier, so I drilled a hole in the sink top and installed it. I didn't want a hole in the top, but the hole is as small as a hose, so it is not that noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so the hole or hose is not visible. There is no outlet in the place where I installed it, so I need a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have neatly attached the multi-cord, but they couldn't do that. The installation was neat and they were kind. The functions are in the following order: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High-temperature wash -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote control -> Wi-Fi -> Add drying -> Automatic door open -> Reservation -> Cancel, Play. The operation buttons are electronic touch-type, so it is easy to touch. You can refer to the manual for instructions, but it is very easy to operate even without looking at it. And it has a Wi-Fi function, so you can operate it with your phone. Cleaning power Oily I put everything in, including a frying pan and dishes, and it all got washed away and it was cleaner than when I wash the dishes. Especially after eating fish, the dishes smell really bad, but there was no smell at all. Before washing the dishes, I first removed the food stuck to the dishes and put it in. If you don't remove it, it will remain in the dishwasher mesh, so it's more annoying to remove it. Also, if there's cheese stuck to it or something stuck to the pot, it won't be washed all the way in. I recommend soaking it in advance and putting it in. Automatic door opening The automatic door opening function is not often used in 6-person dishwashers, but this one has an automatic door opening function, so it's the best. Since both of us earn money, I eat in the morning, put the dishwasher in, run it, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and go to sleep. If there was no automatic door opening function, I would only use it on the weekends or use it all at once in the evening and have to wait until it's done. The automatic door opening is the best. A 6-person machine is said to be a big win-win. It would be nice to have a 12-person or more machine, but since my family tends to cook side dishes all at once, there aren't many dishes on weekdays. The dishes are It's a little bit, but I didn't buy it because I thought it would be burdensome to run a dishwasher for more than 12 people, but after using a 6-person dishwasher, it seems perfect. I think it's perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and people who eat out instead of cooking. And since it's a size that even fits a frying pan, I tried washing dishes by putting in 2 frying pans and 1 pot, and it washed well. If I learn the technique of putting dishes in the dishwasher, I think I'll be able to put in a lot of dishes. I don't have the technique yet, so I can't put in more even though I can. As you can see in the picture, I put in a lot of dishes. I think I have to get used to it as I use it. The moment I use the dishwasher, my quality of life improves and the burden of using dishes decreases. I highly recommend it.
