Comments (English): [ Much needed upgrade! ] || ---------------- || We have used our 2025 Samsung Bespoke dishwasher, model # DW90F89P0USRAA in fingerprint resistant stainless steel, for a little over a week now and it is a much needed upgrade to our old dishwasher! The sleek, handle-less design complements our kitchen very well. and completes our kitchen transformation.We had a quiet dishwasher before, but this 38 dBA one is whisper quiet compared to our old one. You pretty much have to be standing directly in front of it to hear it running. This model has no handle, so it takes a bit to figure out how to apply the correct amount of pressure in the proper location for the auto-open door to function; but after that, it works flawlessly. In the event of a power failure, there is a tool that can be used to open the door. This dishwasher has a 3rd Rack Washing System. It is smaller that what we have been used to, so if you use a lot of utensils, some of them will have to be placed into the Cutlery Basket in the lower rack. One other feature we really like is the cup wash area. There is an individual nozzle for each cup or glass. This area can hold 6 coffee cups and 6 glasses. There are also several dedicated areas for washing wine glasses. This dishwasher has 9 wash cycles plus Self Clean, but we have only used AI Wash and have been very happy with the results from this cycle. There is a Smart Dry with Auto Release function on the door. After using the Smart Dry feature, which uses an internal heater to dry the dishes, the door automatically opens to allow further drying. We like the Smart Dry feature, but you have to select it every single time you run the dishwasher.The Samsung SmartThings apps works well with this unit and allows many functions from your phone. Overall, we have been very happy with this dishwasher. One area of concern for us is that the 120V power cord hooks up to the unit in the front left corner as opposed to most models with the cord in the back. The cord runs along a channel to the back from there to hook up to the electrical outlet. Unfortunately for us, the cord is slightly too short and we had to do some electrical modifications to plug it in. We wish that the cord was attached in the back, giving us the length that we needed. Overall, we are very happy with this purchase!

Comments (English): [ Buyer Beware & Check The Warranty!  ] || ---------------- || Boy, if I could give this negative stars, I would! I don't usually do these, but I feel the need to address this machine to anyone looking to buy it, but more importantly, to express our dissatisfaction with the warranty team (Platinum Factory Service) and Whirlpool's Corporate Office (ie., Melissa. "I don't give my last name"). We bought this as a replacement to another Whirlpool machine we had (worked fine for years). About 8-9 months in, we began to notice puddles of water in the front, under the door. The foam backing, behind the door was completely saturated after a cycle had finished. We contacted Whirlpool & they sent out their "Platinum Service technician", who for intents and purposes was a joke! Unfortunately for us, he was the only technician authorized to work on the machine, literally the ONLY ONE! For the warranty call, they will tell you the date they will arrive, but you better make sure you have sick time or PTO, because they give you a four hour range to work with and they call you within a half hour of the appt when they will arrive. The repair tech told us it was fixed after the second visit, but it leaked after the first use, worse than the original leakage! So, after two failed repairs, we called corporate who set up another appt, along with a "master tech" (by phone) to assist the repair guy. We waited almost 3 weeks for him to come back out. He was talking with the master tech as I was standing there and they were going to replace the tower (for a leak in the front of the door)! The repair guy told us that he wished he would have known it was still leaking (maybe corporate and their warranty dept should communicate better). The repair tech was there 10 minutes was ready to leave. I said, wait, are you leaving? He said I don't have the parts and I have to go by what the master tech tells me to do. That's when I'd had enough! I spoke with Melissa (corporate) and she said the repair would need to be scheduled, but that they'd have to find another technician (apparently I hurt the guy's feelings). Melissa said the warranty is only for repair work, not for replacements. I'm sorry, but if your product is defective, and your warranty guy says it's fixed ("50 years experience" by the way) and yet is still leaking, I believe you should replace the product (and I'm not talking about a 15% discount Carrol). HEY WHIRLPOOL. STAND BY YOUR PRODUCT! No resolution to date!

Sentence (English): We have used our 2025 Samsung Bespoke dishwasher, model # DW90F89P0USRAA in fingerprint resistant stainless steel, for a little over a week now and it is a much needed upgrade to our old dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Much needed upgrade! ] || ---------------- || We have used our 2025 Samsung Bespoke dishwasher, model # DW90F89P0USRAA in fingerprint resistant stainless steel, for a little over a week now and it is a much needed upgrade to our old dishwasher! The sleek, handle-less design complements our kitchen very well. and completes our kitchen transformation. We had a quiet dishwasher before, but this 38 dBA one is whisper quiet compared to our old one. You pretty much have to be standing directly in front of it to hear it running. This model has no handle, so it takes a bit to figure out how to apply the correct amount of pressure in the proper location for the auto-open door to function; but after that, it works flawlessly. In the event of a power failure, there is a tool that can be used to open the door. This dishwasher has a 3rd Rack Washing System. It is smaller that what we have been used to, so if you use a lot of utensils, some of them will have to be placed into the Cutlery Basket in the lower rack. Sentence (English): When we moved into our house, we had a very basic and very loud dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Silent, Powerful Cleaning! ] || ---------------- || When we moved into our house, we had a very basic and very loud dishwasher. It had basically no options and the cleaning power was pretty bad, we mostly handwashed dishes. I heard nothing but good things about Samsung dishwashers so I was excited to give this one a shot. After the delivery guys installed it, we powered it on and it instantly wanted to connect through the Smart Things app! Once I allowed it, I literally didn't have to do anything else, Smart Things had connected it to the Wi-Fi and started an update. This is truly one of the best parts of having the Smart Things app.Once it was time to start a wash cycle, I was met with a plethora of options for cycle types. I went with the AI Wash cycle and let it go. This thing is so quiet I didn't realize it was running, I actually panicked a little at first. When the cycle was done, I was met with DRY and sparkling clean dishes. I used a basic detergent as i don't use the pods and was still met with amazing results. After using the dishwasher many times by this point, the only problem I have had so far is that when I opened the dishwasher mid-cycle, it would not restart and I basically just had to turn it off and then on again. This hasn't happened since. There was a software update since then, so I'm not sure if the problem was addressed or if it was just a one time fluke. Also, when we got the dishwasher delivered, it was a little banged up at the bottom. Not a big deal as it is purely aesthetic, but worth mentioning.Overall, I am completely blown away by this dishwasher. It's impressive how clean my dishes can get, with little to no pre-washing, from a machine that is so quiet you can barely tell it's running! I am beyond amazed and completely happy with this dishwasher!

Sentence (English): The dw80r9950ug has not worked well.
Comments (English): [ Unreliable, bad at cleaning, and bad at drying ] || ---------------- || The dw80r9950ug has not worked well. We purchased it in November 2021. We decided on this model, due to the 3rd rack, very quiet operations, and ratings for drying. At the price point (upper tier), we expected a great machine.When we first got it, it cleaned OK. Not great. We definitely had to keep scraping and rinsing. Not what I wanted for $1100.A top criterion for us was drying. It has never dried well. Working with Samsung support, they stressed Jet Dry, which we use, and they said that plastic dishes tend not to dry well. They are correct. What annoys me is that when we go to VRBOs, the low end dishwashers in those places far outperform our dw80r9950ug in cleaning and drying.I will give it this. This thing is very quiet. I can stand next to it while it runs and not realize it's on. The (lack of) noise is exactly as advertised and very impressive.Less than a year after we got it, we had to have the linear wash (waterwall) device replaced. This was under warranty. After that, it returned to cleaning just OK.We are now at 3.5 years, and it has stopped cleaning well for the last 2-3 months. We normally have to hand wash many of the dishes after a cycle. We had a reputable and experience repair person here today who showed us that the waterwall arm was again not working. It doesn't move. Then he said that Samsung has discontinued this part, and I have since verified that with other parts sellers. I guess I have to buy a new dishwasher.Based on this and the Samsung refrigerator I purchased 10 years ago, I will strongly recommend against purchasing this dishwasher and Samsung appliances in general.

Sentence (English): We have had our dishwasher for about 18 months.
Comments (English): [ Poor quality control ] || ---------------- || We have had our dishwasher for about 18 months. It has now had two major problems. The first was the failure of the front panel circuit board. The second, as of a month ago, is the failure of the power control module, apparently caused by an unidentified water leak. We're just lucky that the leak, which was not visible to us, doesn't seem to have caused subfloor rot or damage. In order to even identify where the leak is, the Bosch service tech said we'd have to pay over $500 to install the new power module. The complete failure of quality control is enough to never want to buy a Bosch product again. It doesn't matter how well a dishwasher cleans if it won't turn on or hold water. Sentence (English): This was a no brainer purchase.
Comments (English): [ Worth the investment ] || ---------------- || This was a no brainer purchase. We have been looking for a dishwasher for a few months, and folks who we knew had Bosch loved them. When a technician came out to fix my GE Profile dishwasher, he recommend getting a dishwasher in the $1000 range or higher, as these worked better and had less problems in general. The drain motor he replaced was $300, which was as much as a new cheap dishwasher. This was going to be a pricey purchase, but with the instore sale (these was not advertised online. another $300 off), Memorial Day sale and Lowe's 0% financing, we got an awesome deal on this dishwasher. A few things I love about this dishwasher:1. A separate 3rd rack for utensils. This cleans so much better than clumping all the utensils in a basket.2. A filter to capture debris. My previous GE Profile didn't have a catch basin, so food would clog the drain pipe and broke the motor. The clog pipe was probably one of the reason why it didn't clean well.3. It's super super quiet compare to any of the dishwashers I use to have. You can watch TV with the volume at a normal setting.4. We could wash plastic without fear of it melting, as it uses a non-conventual heating element.5. The AutoAir feature (where the door opens automatically and let the steam vent out), is great for those who know that dishes are still wet unless you open that door manually. Becareful for those wooden counters, as you will need to protect it from swelling. My installer did not install the vapor barrier, so I need to make one or get them back to install it.The only Con, the angle of the tines are angled too much of my dishes. We just need to figure out the best way to load the dishwasher.BTW, these are built in North Carolina, so it avoids the current tariffs.

Comments (English): [ The groom made a pedestal to store detergent underneath, and it's perfect! ] || ---------------- || I turned it on at night and checked in the morning that there was a little moisture because it had dried naturally with the automatic door open function. Sentence (English): As a family of three, we previously used an 8-person dishwasher, but we purchased the LG Dios Object Collection dishwasher after moving.
Comments (English): As a family of three, we previously used an 8-person dishwasher, but we purchased the LG Dios Object Collection dishwasher after moving. To sum it up, it’s a great deal. It’s spacious and comfortable. It can hold a frying pan, pressure cooker, and pot! I chose the Nature Beige color, and it matches the Nature Oak + Matte White sink without any sense of incongruity. When I designed the interior, I made the sink considering the dishwasher space, so it looks more customized. You can also specify the installation date, and I received a confirmation KakaoTalk message as the date approached. The friendly delivery person contacted me frequently, installed it neatly, and explained the usage in detail. I usually use it in automatic mode, and it takes about 1 hour and 50 minutes to dry. It works really quietly even in automatic mode, so sometimes I put my ear up to check if it was working properly. On the other hand, it’s quiet, and the tornado cleaning blade washes it coolly without any blind spots, so I’m satisfied. If you use it with rinse or salt, it won't leave water marks, but I only use salt and my dishes are born without stains. The unique thing is that it has a two-tier structure and has to be placed in a container without a net to spread out the spoons, but I knew this in advance and I prefer the spoon container type, so I use it without much inconvenience. It's a satisfactory dishwasher without any shortcomings. I want to take good care of it and use it for a long time. I recommend it.

The top and sides are made of stainless steel, but the bottom is made of plastic, so it dries slowly and there are a lot of water droplets on the floor. Reason 3: It doesn't have a sterilizing function. Reason 4: It's cheap. The tray angle doesn't lie flat, which is inconvenient. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well because they didn't dissolve well, so I tried various detergents to see if it was a problem with the dishwasher or the detergent. I tried three types in total: 1 tablet, liquid, and powder. When I put in 1 tablet, it was detergent + enzyme + rinse. The rinse didn't work, so I bought the liquid again and used it. The liquid was better than putting in 1 tablet, but it often didn't work properly. However, the powder detergent that my neighbor gave me was really good, so I chose the powder and am using it now. There is a liquid that you tear the plastic and use, so I'm going to try that next time. And if I don't use the rinse, water droplets stain the dishes, so it's good to use it. It was good for the price as a beginner, but if I buy it again next time, I'll choose the 12-person size and use the stainless steel bottom. I'll choose the one with separate sterilization and drying functions. The installation time is between 10 and 30 minutes. If you install it near the water purifier, it will take 10 minutes. If you drill a hole and install it in a place where there is no water purifier, it seems to take more than 30 minutes. I initially installed it in the place where the water purifier was, but I think you won't regret it if you install it in the most convenient place. I didn't like the hose sticking out too far and I didn't want to have to drill another hole, so I installed it near the water purifier, but the technician asked me to come back, so I drilled a hole again a week later and reinstalled it. The technician's visit cost was 40,000 won and the hose additional cost was 10,000 won, so we bought the hose ourselves and only paid the technician 40,000 won for the visit cost. *User review Why is it cheap! I found out why, but I'm writing this after using it for about a month~ Reason 1: It's cheap. Since the media dishwasher uses a residual heat drying method, more than 50% of the moisture remains after the dishes are washed, so I close the door for more than 30 minutes to dry them with the remaining residual heat drying, and then leave the door slightly open. If I wash the dishes in the evening, they don't dry well to the point that I have to clean them up around 12 noon the next day. Reason 2: It's cheap. The top and sides are made of stainless steel, but the bottom is made of plastic, so it dries slowly and there are a lot of water droplets on the floor. Reason 3: It doesn't have a sterilizing function. Reason 4: It's cheap. The tray angle doesn't lie flat, which is inconvenient. Large dishes such as pots and frying pans are bulky, but the tray itself doesn't lie flat, so the space is cramped. It's for 6 people, but in reality, it's a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a plate. After putting in a few cups, there isn't enough space, and I thought that two people wouldn't be able to wash many dishes, but in fact, when you boil soup, a pot and a rice cooker come out, so you have to wash half of it yourself or divide it into two, but it doesn't dry right away and there is no separate drying function, so it's actually impossible to use it twice in a row. *Summary (Advantages) It's good for basket dishes like fish and pork belly because it can be washed at high temperature. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well, but when I used powder detergent, they were cleaned cleanly, but at first, the dishes didn't wash well, so I washed them twice, and it turned out to be because of the detergent. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well because they didn't dissolve well, so I tried various detergents to see if it was a problem with the dishwasher or the detergent. I tried three types in total: 1 tablet, liquid, and powder. When I put in 1 tablet, it was detergent + enzyme + rinse. The rinse didn't work, so I bought the liquid again and used it. The liquid was better than putting in 1 tablet, but it often didn't work properly. However, the powder detergent that my neighbor gave me was really good, so I chose the powder and am using it now. There is a liquid that you tear the plastic and use, so I'm going to try that next time. And if I don't use the rinse, water droplets stain the dishes, so it's good to use it. It was good for the price as a beginner, but if I buy it again next time, I'll choose the 12-person size and use the stainless steel bottom. I'll choose the one with separate sterilization and drying functions. And it is said that only the top is washed with a small amount of dishes~ I also didn't know much because it was my first time using a dishwasher, so I left a haphazard review in case it would be helpful! 11.11.8 One-month review I'm leaving an additional review because the dishes are so hard to wash! I usually spin the P2 standard for 59 minutes because it's full if I put in a few, so I do half myself and only put in half, but there were stains on the dishes, so I even changed it to liquid detergent, but it didn't work so well, so I thought there was a problem with the product, so I brought my neighbor who couldn't live without a dishwasher to help me learn how to put the dishes, but even though I didn't have a lot of dishes, the dishes really didn't wash well. I tried to use it without complaining because it was cheap, but I usually wash the dishes twice or wash them myself again. I'll use it more and revise the rating after using it a little more, whether it was my mistake or the detergent, but I only spun one frying pan that didn't get cleaned, and it didn't get cleaned until the end, even though it wasn't hard or too hard. Detergent selection is important, and the direction and location of the dishes are also important, but ultimately, I think there are dishwashers that don't clean well. How to dry after using a dishwasher After washing is complete and the red END light turns off, if you leave the dishwasher door wide open, it will dry more quickly (residual heat drying method)

I initially installed it in the place where the water purifier was, but I think you won't regret it if you install it in the most convenient place. If I wash the dishes in the evening, they don't dry well to the point that I have to clean them up around 12 noon the next day. Reason 2: It's cheap. The top and sides are made of stainless steel, but the bottom is made of plastic, so it dries slowly and there are a lot of water droplets on the floor. Reason 3: It doesn't have a sterilizing function. Reason 4: It's cheap. The tray angle doesn't lie flat, which is inconvenient. Large dishes such as pots and frying pans are bulky, but the tray itself doesn't lie flat, so the space is cramped. It's for 6 people, but in reality, it's a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a plate. After putting in a few cups, there isn't enough space, and I thought that two people wouldn't be able to wash many dishes, but in fact, when you boil soup, a pot and a rice cooker come out, so you have to wash half of it yourself or divide it into two, but it doesn't dry right away and there is no separate drying function, so it's actually impossible to use it twice in a row. *Summary (Advantages) It's good for basket dishes like fish and pork belly because it can be washed at high temperature. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well, but when I used powder detergent, they were cleaned cleanly, but at first, the dishes didn't wash well, so I washed them twice, and it turned out to be because of the detergent. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well because they didn't dissolve well, so I tried various detergents to see if it was a problem with the dishwasher or the detergent. I tried three types in total: 1 tablet, liquid, and powder. When I put in 1 tablet, it was detergent + enzyme + rinse. The rinse didn't work, so I bought the liquid again and used it. The liquid was better than putting in 1 tablet, but it often didn't work properly. However, the powder detergent that my neighbor gave me was really good, so I chose the powder and am using it now. There is a liquid that you tear the plastic and use, so I'm going to try that next time. And if I don't use the rinse, water droplets stain the dishes, so it's good to use it. It was good for the price as a beginner, but if I buy it again next time, I'll choose the 12-person size and use the stainless steel bottom. I'll choose the one with separate sterilization and drying functions. I tried to use it without complaining because it was cheap, but I usually wash the dishes twice or wash them myself again. I'll use it more and revise the rating after using it a little more, whether it was my mistake or the detergent, but I only spun one frying pan that didn't get cleaned, and it didn't get cleaned until the end, even though it wasn't hard or too hard. Detergent selection is important, and the direction and location of the dishes are also important, but ultimately, I think there are dishwashers that don't clean well. How to dry after using a dishwasher After washing is complete and the red END light turns off, if you leave the dishwasher door wide open, it will dry more quickly (residual heat drying method)

The technician's visit cost was 40,000 won and the hose additional cost was 10,000 won, so we bought the hose ourselves and only paid the technician 40,000 won for the visit cost. *User review Why is it cheap! I found out why, but I'm writing this after using it for about a month~ Reason 1: It's cheap. Since the media dishwasher uses a residual heat drying method, more than 50% of the moisture remains after the dishes are washed, so I close the door for more than 30 minutes to dry them with the remaining residual heat drying, and then leave the door slightly open. If I wash the dishes in the evening, they don't dry well to the point that I have to clean them up around 12 noon the next day. Reason 2: It's cheap. The top and sides are made of stainless steel, but the bottom is made of plastic, so it dries slowly and there are a lot of water droplets on the floor. Reason 3: It doesn't have a sterilizing function. Reason 4: It's cheap. The tray angle doesn't lie flat, which is inconvenient. Large dishes such as pots and frying pans are bulky, but the tray itself doesn't lie flat, so the space is cramped. It's for 6 people, but in reality, it's a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a plate. After putting in a few cups, there isn't enough space, and I thought that two people wouldn't be able to wash many dishes, but in fact, when you boil soup, a pot and a rice cooker come out, so you have to wash half of it yourself or divide it into two, but it doesn't dry right away and there is no separate drying function, so it's actually impossible to use it twice in a row. *Summary (Advantages) It's good for basket dishes like fish and pork belly because it can be washed at high temperature. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well, but when I used powder detergent, they were cleaned cleanly, but at first, the dishes didn't wash well, so I washed them twice, and it turned out to be because of the detergent. There were times when the dishes didn't wash well because they didn't dissolve well, so I tried various detergents to see if it was a problem with the dishwasher or the detergent. I tried three types in total: 1 tablet, liquid, and powder. When I put in 1 tablet, it was detergent + enzyme + rinse. The rinse didn't work, so I bought the liquid again and used it. The liquid was better than putting in 1 tablet, but it often didn't work properly. However, the powder detergent that my neighbor gave me was really good, so I chose the powder and am using it now. There is a liquid that you tear the plastic and use, so I'm going to try that next time. And if I don't use the rinse, water droplets stain the dishes, so it's good to use it. It was good for the price as a beginner, but if I buy it again next time, I'll choose the 12-person size and use the stainless steel bottom. I'll choose the one with separate sterilization and drying functions. And it is said that only the top is washed with a small amount of dishes~ I also didn't know much because it was my first time using a dishwasher, so I left a haphazard review in case it would be helpful! 11.11.8 One-month review I'm leaving an additional review because the dishes are so hard to wash! I usually spin the P2 standard for 59 minutes because it's full if I put in a few, so I do half myself and only put in half, but there were stains on the dishes, so I even changed it to liquid detergent, but it didn't work so well, so I thought there was a problem with the product, so I brought my neighbor who couldn't live without a dishwasher to help me learn how to put the dishes, but even though I didn't have a lot of dishes, the dishes really didn't wash well. I tried to use it without complaining because it was cheap, but I usually wash the dishes twice or wash them myself again. I'll use it more and revise the rating after using it a little more, whether it was my mistake or the detergent, but I only spun one frying pan that didn't get cleaned, and it didn't get cleaned until the end, even though it wasn't hard or too hard. Detergent selection is important, and the direction and location of the dishes are also important, but ultimately, I think there are dishwashers that don't clean well. How to dry after using a dishwasher After washing is complete and the red END light turns off, if you leave the dishwasher door wide open, it will dry more quickly (residual heat drying method)

Sentence (English): When we moved into our house, we had a very basic and very loud dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Silent, Powerful Cleaning! ] || ---------------- || When we moved into our house, we had a very basic and very loud dishwasher. It had basically no options and the cleaning power was pretty bad, we mostly handwashed dishes. I heard nothing but good things about Samsung dishwashers so I was excited to give this one a shot. After the delivery guys installed it, we powered it on and it instantly wanted to connect through the Smart Things app! Once I allowed it, I literally didn't have to do anything else, Smart Things had connected it to the Wi-Fi and started an update. This is truly one of the best parts of having the Smart Things app. Once it was time to start a wash cycle, I was met with a plethora of options for cycle types. I went with the AI Wash cycle and let it go. This thing is so quiet I didn't realize it was running, I actually panicked a little at first. When the cycle was done, I was met with DRY and sparkling clean dishes. I used a basic detergent as i don't use the pods and was still met with amazing results. After using the dishwasher many times by this point, the only problem I have had so far is that when I opened the dishwasher mid-cycle, it would not restart and I basically just had to turn it off and then on again. This hasn't happened since. There was a software update since then, so I'm not sure if the problem was addressed or if it was just a one time fluke. Also, when we got the dishwasher delivered, it was a little banged up at the bottom. Not a big deal as it is purely aesthetic, but worth mentioning. Overall, I am completely blown away by this dishwasher. It's impressive how clean my dishes can get, with little to no pre-washing, from a machine that is so quiet you can barely tell it's running! I am beyond amazed and completely happy with this dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I am writing this about 2 years after I installed it.
Comments (English): [ Good washer, DO NOT Hardwire tho (develops the need for frequent unplugging after 12-24 months) ] || ---------------- || I am writing this about 2 years after I installed it. Very good dishwasher absolutely love the top rack even if you don't think you're going to use one with a top rack get it it is so useful for kitchen tools and the like. This is a very affordable dishwasher as such there are compromises. One of those compromises that you need to know is after a certain amount of time (in my case 18 months) it developed an error code that says basically cut off power and try again which caused it to work fine it's just one of the electronic switches that goes iffy, if you Google this model number online you can see people talking about it unplugging and replugging gets rid of the area code and you run a successful 3-hour wash. It was taking about once every 20 washes (3 weeks) I would have to unplug it I have taken the step of leaving it unplugged until I want to use it and another 6 months later I've not gotten a single code so I strongly advise you wire this to a plug and not hardwire. Otherwise absolutely no complaints.

Sentence (English): We've had the BOSCH 300 Series Dishwasher (SHE53B75UC) for a little while now, and overall, we're really happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Reliable, and Mostly Excellent ] || ---------------- || We've had the BOSCH 300 Series Dishwasher (SHE53B75UC) for a little while now, and overall, we're really happy with it. It's a solid machine—quiet, efficient, and gets the dishes nice and clean. It also runs a bit quicker than we expected, which is a pleasant surprise. That said, there are a few things we've noticed. The drying could definitely be better—some dishes, especially plastic ones, still come out a little damp. And we really miss the handle that our older Bosch had. It may seem small, but it was super convenient for hanging a kitchen towel, and we didn't realize how much we'd miss that simple feature. The Wi-Fi and app integration work fine, but to be honest, we don't really use them much. It's a cool option to have, but not something we consider essential. One minor annoyance is the front of the machine—it looks great, but it's very sensitive to fingerprints and smudges. If your hands are even slightly oily or wet, it shows, and we find ourselves wiping it down often just to keep it looking clean. All in all, it's a great dishwasher that does its main job really well. A few small tweaks would make it perfect, but we're definitely satisfied with the purchase.

Sentence (English): First: the price is very good, especially with inclusion of delivery & installation as those costs are about $200-$250 at the big home improvement places (they might say part of it is "free" but that is a rebate and/or gift card you can only use at that store).
Comments (English): [ Good Price, But Wet Dishes and No Delay Start ] || ---------------- || First: the price is very good, especially with inclusion of delivery & installation as those costs are about $200-$250 at the big home improvement places (they might say part of it is "free" but that is a rebate and/or gift card you can only use at that store). Just make sure installers will be able to plug it in at an acceptable outlet; the ones I had did a great job. The stainless does seem easy to keep clean. However this washer ends with a VERY wet load AND machine without running the extended dry, and even then it will not completely dry the items or interior (and yes I keep the rinse aid compartment filled). I leave the door cracked so I'm not operating a mold incubator. And even though this seems like a mid level model, it has no delay start feature. Luckily it is pretty quiet, so if I turn it on at bedtime, I don't really hear it. But odd since even most of the cheapest d/w units come with delay start. I like the arrangement of the racks for capacity, though stemware is not as secure as I'd like. Overall I wish I'd made a different choice.

Sentence (English): I'm 70 and probably owned 10 dishwashers over the years.
Comments (English): [ Best I've Ever Owned ] || ---------------- || I'm 70 and probably owned 10 dishwashers over the years. I believe dishwasher quality went downhill in the late 1990's. Researching online made it easy to find a new one, and after a few days, I chose the Bosch 300 Series. Made in the USA, this model stood out for its many positive reviews and detailed online information. Still, I was skeptical, as it's hard to trust reviews these days.The dishwasher exceeded all my expectations, I'm completely satisfied and frankly surprised. The Bosch cleans and dries beautifully, even pots and pans with "salt rings" from boiling pasta and long-simmering tomato sauce. They all come out sparkling clean. The Bosch 300 is very quiet and the control panel is easy to use. I ordered my Bosch 300 using the Lowe's app expecting a third rack usedfor flatware and miscellaneous items. However mine has two racks and (a different model number). I didn't notice until after delivery and decided to keep it.The extra headspace on the top rack is actually more useful for my needs, so I'm satisfied. The only complaint I have is the flatware basket is too small and doesn't hold large utensils. Fortunately the baskets from my old dishwasher fit solving the problem. (I've included a photo). I hope the Bosch 300 is the last dishwasher we have to buy.

Comments (English): [ Aunt Dishwasher, your sister's house dispatch was also a success~! ] || ---------------- || (In the last review) I used the BESPOKE countertop 6-person dishwasher and liked it so much that I gave it to my sister as a gift for her moving house. Recently, I had a housewarming party and went to see the dishwasher I gave her in person. ^^ My sister had to drill a hole to pass the water hose through, but they installed it really well so that it was completely out of sight in the corner. In addition, the power cord had to be pulled in, so it could have looked a little messy, but they even gave me a sling. It was nice to see it organized neatly. I only use it once a day, in the evening. My sister also said that she uses it well and likes it~ ^^b I have been using it for over 5 months now. I use it every day without missing a day, to the point where I wonder, 'How did I live without it~'. Now that I have gotten a little more skilled at it, the time I spend stacking dishes has been reduced considerably. ^^ One thing that I have felt a little regretful about while using it so far. It is not a problem with the device, but rather an inconvenience due to the structural installation~ The inlet of the dishwasher is caught in the faucet and cannot open toward the sink, so when I put the dishes in, water inevitably falls on the floor. (My sister's house has an entrance facing the sink, so you can pour water right in without spilling it.) I think it would be good for those installing it to check this part. If possible, put the entrance on the sink side~! ^^ I was wondering if it was installed properly after giving it as a gift and if it was being used well. Fortunately, I'm glad that you're using it well and liking it, so I'm happy~ -------------------- I hope this review was helpful. Thank you~ ^^

Sentence (English): The dw80r9950ug has not worked well.
Comments (English): [ Unreliable, bad at cleaning, and bad at drying ] || ---------------- || The dw80r9950ug has not worked well. We purchased it in November 2021. We decided on this model, due to the 3rd rack, very quiet operations, and ratings for drying. At the price point (upper tier), we expected a great machine. When we first got it, it cleaned OK. Not great. We definitely had to keep scraping and rinsing. Not what I wanted for $1100. A top criterion for us was drying. It has never dried well. Working with Samsung support, they stressed Jet Dry, which we use, and they said that plastic dishes tend not to dry well. They are correct. What annoys me is that when we go to VRBOs, the low end dishwashers in those places far outperform our dw80r9950ug in cleaning and drying. I will give it this. This thing is very quiet. I can stand next to it while it runs and not realize it's on. The (lack of) noise is exactly as advertised and very impressive. Less than a year after we got it, we had to have the linear wash (waterwall) device replaced. This was under warranty. After that, it returned to cleaning just OK. We are now at 3.5 years, and it has stopped cleaning well for the last 2-3 months. We normally have to hand wash many of the dishes after a cycle. We had a reputable and experience repair person here today who showed us that the waterwall arm was again not working. It doesn't move. Then he said that Samsung has discontinued this part, and I have since verified that with other parts sellers. I guess I have to buy a new dishwasher. Based on this and the Samsung refrigerator I purchased 10 years ago, I will strongly recommend against purchasing this dishwasher and Samsung appliances in general.

Sentence (English): LG DUE6BGL3E dishwasher review.
Comments (English): [ LG DUE6BGL3E Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || LG DUE6BGL3E dishwasher review. Honestly, I didn't know I would use the dishwasher this often and with such satisfaction. Since I have a family of 3~4, I wash a lot of dishes for every meal, but now I hardly wash dishes by hand. What I liked. I'm really satisfied with the cleaning power. It washes away greasy frying pans and rice bowls with sticky rice cleanly. Thanks to the 100-degree steam cleaning function, I don't have to worry about bacteria. There's no smell from the dishes, and they're fluffy after washing. It's large enough for 14 people. At first, I thought it was too big, but I was able to put in soup bowls, pots, and children's plates, so I was able to wash them all at once! The 3-tier shelf is also height-adjustable, so it's easy to put in tall cups or wine glasses. The design is pretty, so I'm very satisfied. I chose the Objet Collection Nature Beige color, and it matches well with the kitchen atmosphere. I only changed one appliance, but it has an interior effect. It's secretly convenient that it can be controlled by an app. I like that I can operate it with the app even after putting the dishes in and going out, and I can check the remaining time. Disappointing points. The control panel is on the front, so it's a bit inconvenient. I felt it was a bit inconvenient at first because I had to bend down. I heard there's a model on the top, so I think some people might consider that. The price is a bit high. I was worried because there are cheaper models with similar capacity, but I don't regret it when I think about the design and functions. Overall review. In conclusion, it's a **'product worth the money'**. I especially recommend it to those who are using a dishwasher for the first time or to those who need a large capacity for a family. Since I save time washing dishes and take care of hygiene, I feel like my life satisfaction has definitely increased.
Comments (Original): [ LG DUE6BGL3E 식기세척기 사 ] || ---------------- || LG DUE6BGL3E 식기세척기 사용 후기솔직히 식기세척기를 이렇게 자주, 그리고 만족스럽게 쓰게 될 줄은 몰랐어요.3~4인 가족이라 매 끼니마다 설거지 양도 꽤 되는데, 이제는 손 설거지 거의 안 해요.✅ 마음에 들었던 점•세척력 정말 만족스러워요.기름진 프라이팬, 밥풀 눌러붙은 밥그릇도 말끔하게 닦여요. 100도 스팀 세척 기능 덕분인지 세균 걱정도 덜하구요.식기에서 냄새도 안 나고, 닦고 나면 뽀송뽀송해요.•14인용이라 용량 넉넉해요.처음엔 너무 큰가 싶었는데, 국그릇, 냄비, 아이들 식판까지 다 넣고도 여유가 있어서 한 번에 세척 끝!3단 선반도 높이 조절되니까 긴 컵이나 와인잔 넣기도 편하더라고요.•디자인이 예뻐서 만족도 업.저는 오브제컬렉션 네이처 베이지 색상으로 골랐는데, 주방 분위기랑 잘 어울려요.가전 하나 바꿨을 뿐인데 인테리어 효과가 있네요.•앱으로 제어 가능한 게 은근 편해요.식기 넣고 외출해도 앱으로 작동시킬 수 있고, 남은 시간도 확인 가능해서 좋더라고요.❗ 아쉬운 점•조작부가 전면에 있어서 약간 불편해요.허리를 숙여야 해서 처음엔 조금 번거롭다고 느꼈어요.위쪽에 있는 모델도 있다고 하던데, 그런 거 고려하시는 분들도 있을 듯해요.•가격이 조금 센 편이에요.비슷한 용량에 더 저렴한 모델도 있어서 고민했는데, 그래도 디자인이나 기능 생각하면 후회는 없어요.⸻✅ 총평결론적으로 **‘돈이 아깝지 않은 제품’**이에요.식기세척기 처음 써보는 분들이나, 가족 단위로 넉넉한 용량 필요하신 분들께 특히 추천드려요.설거지 시간 아끼고 위생까지 챙기니까, 생활 만족도가 확 올라간 느낌이에요

Comments (English): [ Unexpected Accessory ] || ---------------- || My issue is not with the dishwasher, but with the delivery. I loved my new LG for the very short time I had it. When he pulled out dishwasher he discovered that a mouse had made a very nice home up in the motor area and had chewed many of the wires to the motor. Of course, "mouse house" in motor is not covered by any warranty. Clearly the mouse CAME WITH the dishwasher. So I'm still paying for the dishwasher, that of course had to be trashed, paid for a 3 year warranty that is no longer any good, and when I finish paying for the dishwasher, will need reorder a new one. I don't have 5, so I'll give it 3. I'm a mom raising an 11-month-old baby. The reason I bought the dishwasher was because I wanted to escape the hell of baby food and bottle dishwashing. I'm currently living in a small rented house, and the sink is also small, so if I wash the baby's dishes and eat one meal by myself, the sink is full. I don't have time to wash dishes because I'm a single parent and a mom. I was so stressed out that I looked into a dishwasher, but since it's a rented house, installing a big one was burdensome, and since we're a family of 3, I chose a 6-person one! I had high expectations because the reviews were so good. At first, I was so, so disappointed when I washed the baby's dishes. The baby food scraps wouldn't fall off, and the baby bottles wouldn't be washed at all. Since I only saw good reviews, I wondered if the product I received was defective, so I looked for more reviews, and they all talked about the detergent. At first, I used a heart-shaped bottle-compatible detergent. So I immediately changed it to the most famous frog detergent. The result was. Well, it was so-so. I tried it several times, but even after changing the detergent, there were many cases where it didn't clean the inside of the bottle. The nipples and small parts flew everywhere and fell to the bottom. When I washed it with the baby food bowl, the nipples (all silicone) smelled like food and it was a total mess. So I washed the baby bowls by hand and only washed the adult bowls in the dishwasher. I already tasted the devil, right? I couldn't wash the dishes anymore. So I found a solution! This part is really disappointing. However, because it's so convenient, I decided to change the nipples often and use them. The glass products are very shiny. And the adult ones~ Oil stains are easily removed after changing the detergent, but sometimes when Tetris goes wrong, there are stains~ You have to close your eyes and use it. And. But just spin it~ The pot lid is super clean, so I'm happy. I spun a ceramic cup, but there was a brown stain on the spout, so I wondered if the coffee wouldn't wash off? It was the glaze. I recommend not spinning ceramic products if possible. And after using it a few times, the plastic handle that catches the bottom becomes white and sticky. It's probably detergent residue. If you put citric acid in it and wash it thoroughly, it will be clean. As a result of experimenting and using it in various ways, the dishwasher washes the detergent, detergent residue remains, there are a lot of water stains, and grease is easily removed. You have to ignore the slight discomfort and use it as if you don't know. It's that convenient. The size is a little small to put in something like a pot~ It's enough to cover one or two meals for a two-person household~ When I move next time, I'm going to buy a large one with a water system for 12 people. There's nothing better for using in a small space~ If you can buy a big one, a big one seems better. I wrote it hesitantly, but I hope it helps you when you buy!

Sentence (English): In theory, this dishwasher is amazing.
Comments (English): [ Good for smaller dishes if it works ] || ---------------- || In theory, this dishwasher is amazing. The top rack storm wash and utensil shelf is nice, and I loved that the middle rack could be adjusted to accommodate different sized dishes. It automatically opens when the cycle is done to help dry the dishes, which is cool. I didn't get to use the AI features, but again in theory they sounded good.However: The third rack does make it harder to fit things in the second shelf. The tines that hold plates on the bottom rack are spaced very close together, so if you have plates with any lip or significant curve to them, they will not fit upright between them. If you have dinner plates on the bottom, you can only fit short things on the middle rack, so you lose a lot of space.I also received this particular dishwasher with a dent on the door, and the detergent compartment leaked around the edges where it attached to the inside of the door. Best Buy tried to charge me another delivery fee for a replacement, then after agreeing to replace the defective appliance "for free" never delivered it. Multiple phone calls with customer service each lasting an hour or more, and it ended up being cheaper and less hassle to return the thing and get a different one elsewhere. If you don't have thick plates or too many tall dishes to wash each cycle, this is an okay dishwasher. I'd recommend getting it somewhere other than Best Buy, though, if they're prone to defects instead of ours being a fluke - they will not be helpful in replacing it.

Sentence (English): I've been using a dishwasher for 20 years.
Comments (English): [ I've been using a dishwasher for 20 years. I bought it with my first paycheck. ] || ---------------- || I've been using a dishwasher for 20 years. I bought an LG 12-person dishwasher with my first paycheck and used it for 10 years without any problems. Then, when it broke, I threw it away and bought a new LG. It's been running smoothly ever since. It's quiet, accurate, and great. As I lived here and there, I needed a 6-person dishwasher, so I used a Cuckoo rice cooker for a long time. Then, when other appliances came out, I bought a Cuckoo 6-person dishwasher. However, it had many problems, so I called the service center several times. After using it for 3 years, I'm getting rid of it now. Right after the service center was over, error codes started popping up, so in the last 3 years, I wasted all my money on travel expenses and was diagnosed with a machine that couldn't be repaired. In the meantime, the inner pot of my Cuckoo rice cooker broke (I used it for 8 years), so I switched to a Kuchen stainless steel inner pot while choosing a rice cooker. The rice tastes good from both companies, and the inner pot seems durable because it's made of stainless steel. Cuckoo rice cookers are durable, with no minor issues. I've only had to replace the solenoid valve and packing rubber once, and I've used them for a long time. If the inner pot were stainless steel, I'd still be using them. So, excluding other companies, small and medium-sized enterprises, and Chinese manufacturers, I compared dishwashers between Samsung and LG. I was considering buying an LG even though it was 200,000 won more expensive. However, YouTuber Guigom's analysis video showed that the ceiling of the 6-person storage compartment was made of reinforced plastic, which caused water droplets to form. So, I ended up buying the Samsung. I'd rather use it for 6 years, or even 10 years, than for 3 years with a Cuckoo. I'm hoping for no minor issues. It hasn't been delivered yet, but I received a call. I hope it arrives soon. The photo is of the Cuckoo model before it was dismantled, as it hasn't been delivered yet. The hardware specs seem similar, but durability may vary. As an LG Household & Health Care shareholder, I know Frosch detergent is good, but of course I use *our LG. *Detergent and rinse. I like LG. Please sell a lot. It's a good choice, either Samsung or LG. Samsung offers better service, and I don't have to rely on LG for support.

It also has some little little flap covers for a few of the slots. I think that'll be so nice for small piping tips or baby bottle parts. So far I'm in love with this dishwasher upgrade!

Comments (English): [ Terrible quality and service ] || ---------------- || Installed May 12, and we have still not been able to run a load of dishes as of June 7. We tried the rinse cycle when installed, and my DB meter measured it at over 50 DB, as high as 60 DB, for what is supposed to be a 39DB dishwasher! Way worse than advertised. The feature we wanted, the door opening at the end of the cycle, did work, however. Before we could run a load, though, the plastic "striker" loop from the latch mechanism broke off (our previous KA dishwashers have had a metal striker part). Our first appointment for service via the KA online site never came, and when called said they had no record of the appointment. Sentence (English): LG dishwashers stand out for their powerful and hygienic cleaning power.
Comments (English): LG dishwashers stand out for their powerful and hygienic cleaning power. The 100% hot True Steam effectively removes stuck-on food and removes 99.999% of harmful bacteria and viruses on the surface of dishes. It is especially helpful when washing dishes that require hygiene, such as baby bottles. In addition, the three-dimensional water stream created by the tornado washing blade thoroughly washes every corner of the dishes and completely removes grease. Drying, which is as important as washing, is also an advantage of LG dishwashers. After washing, the door automatically opens to release the hot steam inside and helps with natural drying, reducing water stains. Some high-end models even have a function that dries faster and more thoroughly with hot air, allowing you to use fluffy dishes right away. The smart shelf system, which can efficiently store dishes of various sizes, further enhances user convenience. You can adjust the height in three stages or organize everything from large dishes like pots and frying pans to small dishes like spoons and ladles in a customized manner. Thanks to this, you can leave the dishwasher to do the dishes without worry even when you have a lot of dishes to wash. Quiet operation is also a big advantage. It uses an inverter DD motor to minimize noise and operates in a quiet environment (34dB) like a library. It is even more convenient because you can run the dishwasher late at night or in the early morning without worrying about other people. In addition, various additional functions, such as a partial wash function that saves water and electricity when the amount of dishes is small and the ThinQ function that allows remote control with a smartphone app, provide users with a more convenient kitchen life. LG dishwashers save a lot of water compared to washing dishes by hand, so they are a wise choice that allows you to achieve both hygiene and efficiency even in your busy daily life.

I didn't know the difference and bought it thinking they would all be similar white, but it's a bit disappointing. Sentence (English): We bought this GE to replace a Maytag that failed after 4 years.
Comments (English): [ BASIC Functional Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought this GE to replace a Maytag that failed after 4 years. We are seniors & always had high regard for Whirlpool/Maytag appliances. However , with the failure of the filter/pump assembly after only 4 years, of the Maytag, we decided to try GE. I like the hybrid stainless steel/plastic tub. This keeps the cost down & I figured GE could put more quality into the maim components, the motor, discharge pump & convenient filter. The large easily removable & cleanable fine mesh filter was the selling point for me. The Maytag had a built in under the washer pump motor filter combination that the service guy said would cost $475 to replace. He was honest & advised getting a new dishwasher. Some disappointments: The side trim panels that the instruction said were included but were not. Also missing was the hose clamp that connects the discharge hose to the disposal. The door is much lighter than the one on the Maytag and does not stay open in every position. I am NOT a fan of top door controls, but I did not take off points for this. I knew what I was getting. The instruction sheet/installation sheet is little more than newsprint & GE should embarrassed . I did not find the instructions l all that easy to follow & I have installed several dishwashers. I have rental properties. I knew that I would not be please when the first sentence of the owners manual starts with: "In an effort to conserve the earth's resources , this appliance comes with a CONDENSED MANUAL. Also this manual is written to cover 6 different models. Sometimes gets confusing which model the instructions refer to. Instructions often start out, ' ON SOME MODELS" j What I care about most is how well it cleans & how quickly. The normal cleaning & drying time is about 2hrs & 20 minutes. TOO long for my taste, but that is the world we live in when too many people are concerned about water consumption & quietness. Stand by in 2 years, if it still cleans well & trouble free , I'll upgrade by review to 5 stars.

The tableware holder is nice especially the way it separates each piece; but the top of the holder (with all the holes) always comes out covered with drops of water that easily get on the tableware as we are removing them to put away. I know that we could try using the "Extended heat dry" function, but we don't want to use up that much more electricity. I wish the unit had an air blower (either standard or optional) that would surely help in the drying process.

Since it's a Coupang 2-year free warranty A/S product, I think I'll be able to use it without worrying about it breaking down. * 6-person design compact size * Practical storage efficient internal design * Powerful cleaning wide-type washing blade * Efficient drying system automatic door-opening method When the contamination level is low, it can be used in standard mode, and when the contamination level is high, it can be used in strong mode, so you can choose depending on the situation. Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  제품명 : 미디어 카운터탑 앱연동 자동문열림 6인용 식기세척기, 화이트, MDWTT0608(W)-KR, 방문설치 구매일 : 2025. 02. 11 배송일 : 2025. 02. 21  식기세척기 없어도 사는데 지장 없다~!! 하고 살았는데  한번사용해보디 식기세척기 없었던 삶으로 돌아가기 싫어요~  지방에 내려가 있느라 11일에 구매고 21에 배송 설치 받았어요.  원하는날짜에 설치 받을수 있어서 너무 편리합니다.  방학해서 아이들이 집에서 삼시세끼 먹다보니 밥먹고 설거지 하면 또 밥을 해야하는거 같네요.ㅎㅎ  식기세척기들이고 나니 식사후에 설거지 시간이 없으니 너무 편리합니다.  나만의 시간을 가질수 있어요~  빌트인이 아니라서 설치가 쉬웠어요. 설치기사님께서 오셔서 구멍하나 뚫고 열심히 설치해주시고, 물 세는곳 없나 확인도 해주시고 너무 편리했습니다.  주방이 좁아서 사이즈를 열심히 봤는데, 받고보니 생각했던거보다 살짝 큰거 같아서 당황했지만 설치하고 나니 괜찮았어요.  설명서를 보지 않고서도 작동을 할수 있을 정도로 쉬워서 어르신들 사용하기에도 좋을거 같아요.  식기세척기 돌려놓고 다른일하거나 외출을 해도 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 너무 편리합니다. 식기세척기 전용 세제가 도착하지 않아서 세제없이  기름기 없는 컵이랑 포크, 쌈장종지 돌려봤는데도 깨끗합니다.  깨끗하고 뽀송해서 너무 기분이 좋네요.  6인용이라고 되어있지만 5인가구 국그릇 밥그릇 반찬 접시 다 넣기는 살짝 작은거 같아서 아쉽습니다. 하지만 설거지를 안해도 되니 너무 편리해요. 쿠팡 2년 무상 보증 A/S 상품이라서 고장 걱정 없이 사용할거같아요.  * 6인용 디자인 컴팩트한 사이즈 * 실용적인 수납 효율적인 내부 설계 * 강력한 세척 와이드형 세척날개 * 효율적인 건조 시스템 자동 문 열림 방식  낮은 오염도일때는 표준모드로 높은 오염도 일때는 강력모드로 사용 가능해서 상황에 따라서 선택 가능해요. 대가족은 더 큰 용량의 식세기를 사용해야겠지만, 집에 공간이 작거나 3~4인 가구에서 사용하기에는 안성 맞춤 인거 같아요.

Sentence (English): We are a family of five who wanted to put a dishwasher but couldn't find space on the lower cabinet, so we ended up buying a 6-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): We are a family of five who wanted to put a dishwasher but couldn't find space on the lower cabinet, so we ended up buying a 6-person dishwasher. We were considering LG, Samsung, and Cuckoo 6-person dishwashers, and decided on Samsung. We bought Samsung after considering the price, functions, stainless steel interior, and automatic door opening. All of the home appliances are LG products, and the LG 6-person dishwasher is not that great in all aspects except for the hot air dryer compared to the price. Cuckoo is generally similar to Samsung, but it is cheaper, so I was worried until the end, but I bought Samsung because I had to buy and replace the filter periodically, had to contact Cuckoo customer service after rocket delivery to make an installation date, and the upper part of the interior was not stainless steel. I had it installed today and used it in the evening. I really like it. They always say that it's a new world and your quality of life improves, and it's all true. Two technicians came and installed it, but they said that the spot we wanted was close to the gas range, so it would be difficult to install. However, the only spot we could use comfortably was next to the gas range, so after discussing it with the technician, they installed it where we wanted (it has 3 gas burners, but we decided not to use one burner near the dishwasher). Induction would be fine, but they said that if steam goes into the back of the machine while cooking, an error would pop up, and we would have to disassemble the machine and clean it all up later. I think it took 20-30 minutes to install it. They said that in the past, the technicians would buy the dishwasher detergent with their own money and give it to us, but these days, they give us a one-time code that we can use for an Echo discount. After that, they gave us a tip that the rinse with a frog picture is better, so we should buy that and use it. They told us to use the standard-add rinse-strong dry cycle. They said that if we add rinse, water stains won't remain even without using rinse, and that if we don't press the strong dry button, it won't dry. In addition, Thank you so much for explaining it in detail! The dishwasher was smaller than I thought, but maybe that's why the inside was spacious and there was a lot of space to put dishes, but I couldn't fold and unfold all of them. I'm not very sensitive to noise, but the sound of the dishwasher spinning was a little louder than I thought. However, this is not a big disadvantage. I'd like to say that there are more advantages. ^^ Oh, and there is no user manual. They give you a QR code, but the user manual doesn't come up right away when you scan the QR code, so it's not easy to read. Still, I'm satisfied with the dishwasher! I wrote it in a disorganized manner, but I hope my writing will be of some help to those who are hesitating to buy it :D
Comments (Original): 식세기를 놓고싶은데 하부장에는 도저히 자리가 나질않아 고민하다가 6인용식세기를 구매한 5인가족입니다 우선 lg, 삼성, 쿠쿠 6인용식세기 3제품을 고민하다가 삼성으로 결정했어요 가격, 기능, 내부스텐리스소재, 자동문열림 등 고려해서 삼성으로 구매했는데요 집안 가전은 모두 lg제품인데 lg식세기 6인용은 가격에 비해 열풍건조제외하면 다 별로더라구요.. 쿠쿠는 삼성과 대체적으로 비슷한데 저렴해서 끝까지 고민했으나 필터를 주기적으로 구매해서 갈아줘야한다는점, 로켓배송 후 쿠쿠고객센터로 연결해 설치일자를 예약해야한다는점과 내부상부가 스텐소재가 아니라기에 삼성으로 구매했고 오늘 설치받아서 저녁에 사용했는데 너무 마음에 들어요ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ 항상 신세계다 삶의 질이 올라간다 얘기만들었는데 그 말 다 맞더라고요..  기사님 두분이 오셔서 설치해주셨는데 저희가 원하는 자리는 가스레인지와 가까워서 설치가 어렵다고 말씀주시더라고요ㅠㅠ 그치만 또 편하게 사용할 수 있는 자리가 가스레인지 옆 공간뿐이였어서 기사님과 의논 후 원하는자리에 설치해주셨어요(가스3구짜리인데 식기세척기쪽 1구는 사용하지않는걸로…) 인덕션이면 그나마 괜찮은데 조리하다보면 수증기가 기계뒷면으로 들어가서 에러가뜨면 나중에 기계분해해서 다 닦아야한다고 말씀주셨어요  설치는 20-30분 걸린거같아요 식세기세제를 예전에는 기사님들 사비로 구매해서 나눠주셨다고하셨는데 요즘에는 그대신 에코버할인구매가능한 일회성 코드를 제공해주신다고하더라고요 그 후에 린스는 개구리그림있는게 더 좋다고 그거로 구매해서 사용하라고 팁도 알려주셨어요 코스는 표준-헹굼추가-강력건조로 이용하라고 알려주시더라고요 헹굼추가를해야 린스사용없이도 물얼룩이 잘 남지않는다고하셨고 강력건조를 누르지않으면 건조되지않는다고 하셨어요 그외에도 세세하게 설명해주셔서 너무 감사했어요!!!‍♀️  생각보다 식세기가 컷지만 그래서인지 내부도 넓직했던거같고 접시를 놓을 수 있는 공간은 많았지만 그 공간들을 다 접고 펼수는 없었고 소음에 크게 예민한편은 아니지만 제가 생각했던거보다 식세기 돌아가는 소리는 조금 컷어요 그렇지만 이게 큰 단점은 아니다,, 이점이 더 많다 말씀드리고싶네요^^ 아 그리고 사용설명서는 없고 큐알코드로 주시는데 이게 큐알을 찍으면 바로 사용설명서가 나오는게 아니라 쉽고 편하게 볼 수 있게 되있는건 아니였어요ㅠㅠ,, 그래도 식세기는 만족합니다!! 두서없이 적었지만 구매를 망설이고 계시는분들께 제 글이 조금이라도 도움이되셨으면 좋겠습니다:D

Sentence (English): We were considering LG, Samsung, and Cuckoo 6-person dishwashers, and decided on Samsung.
Comments (English): We are a family of five who wanted to put a dishwasher but couldn't find space on the lower cabinet, so we ended up buying a 6-person dishwasher. We were considering LG, Samsung, and Cuckoo 6-person dishwashers, and decided on Samsung. We bought Samsung after considering the price, functions, stainless steel interior, and automatic door opening. All of the home appliances are LG products, and the LG 6-person dishwasher is not that great in all aspects except for the hot air dryer compared to the price. Cuckoo is generally similar to Samsung, but it is cheaper, so I was worried until the end, but I bought Samsung because I had to buy and replace the filter periodically, had to contact Cuckoo customer service after rocket delivery to make an installation date, and the upper part of the interior was not stainless steel. I had it installed today and used it in the evening. I really like it. They always say that it's a new world and your quality of life improves, and it's all true. Two technicians came and installed it, but they said that the spot we wanted was close to the gas range, so it would be difficult to install. However, the only spot we could use comfortably was next to the gas range, so after discussing it with the technician, they installed it where we wanted (it has 3 gas burners, but we decided not to use one burner near the dishwasher). Induction would be fine, but they said that if steam goes into the back of the machine while cooking, an error would pop up, and we would have to disassemble the machine and clean it all up later. I think it took 20-30 minutes to install it. They said that in the past, the technicians would buy the dishwasher detergent with their own money and give it to us, but these days, they give us a one-time code that we can use for an Echo discount. After that, they gave us a tip that the rinse with a frog picture is better, so we should buy that and use it. They told us to use the standard-add rinse-strong dry cycle. They said that if we add rinse, water stains won't remain even without using rinse, and that if we don't press the strong dry button, it won't dry. In addition, Thank you so much for explaining it in detail! The dishwasher was smaller than I thought, but maybe that's why the inside was spacious and there was a lot of space to put dishes, but I couldn't fold and unfold all of them. I'm not very sensitive to noise, but the sound of the dishwasher spinning was a little louder than I thought. However, this is not a big disadvantage. I'd like to say that there are more advantages. ^^ Oh, and there is no user manual. They give you a QR code, but the user manual doesn't come up right away when you scan the QR code, so it's not easy to read. Still, I'm satisfied with the dishwasher! I wrote it in a disorganized manner, but I hope my writing will be of some help to those who are hesitating to buy it :D

Sentence (English): Can't speak to who we'll this KitchenAid dishwasher will hold up but it was an absolute nightmare to install.
Comments (English): [ Under the hood - Really disappointed ] || ---------------- || Can't speak to who we'll this KitchenAid dishwasher will hold up but it was an absolute nightmare to install. All of the connections (water, electrical and drain hose) are only accessible from the bottom FRONT of the dishwasher. It is necessary to turn the dishwasher bottom side up in order to connect everything ! Let's do this in order:. 1. The electrical cord has stranded wire. However, the terminal block on the machine does not have clamp connectors, only screws which makes it necessary to use spade connections. 2. The drain connection to the machine is also close to the front of the machine and is difficult to reach because of location. 3. Water supply is also near the front of the machine. Why the water connection is terrible is because if a leak develops, it is necessary to remove the machine an turn it upside down to access the leak. Most everything, except the tub and interior is constructed of flemsy plastic. Lastly, terrible instructions printed on cheesy paper. Poorly written.

Sentence (English): I have been using this dishwasher for just over a year: it is the LG DB365TXS model, built-in, made in Korea, with standard dimensions (598 x 815 x 554 mm) and energy consumption between 1600 and 1800 W (IPX2).
Comments (English): [ Don't buy it! ] || ---------------- || I have been using this dishwasher for just over a year: it is the LG DB365TXS model, built-in, made in Korea, with standard dimensions (598 x 815 x 554 mm) and energy consumption between 1600 and 1800 W (IPX2). The design and interface are refined, and the appliance is equipped with numerous digital functions, including connectivity via LG ThinQ. However, the performance in the two main functions - washing and drying - is below expectations. The standard cycles have a very long duration, but the washing efficiency is often unsatisfactory: dishes still dirty or with residues, even after complete cycles. Drying is poor, especially with plastic or light glass dishes.Additional criticality: the need for frequent maintenance, on average every 8–10 washes (cleaning filters, spray arms, drain checks), which compromises its practicality.At first I hypothesized an error in the use or configuration of the programs, but after numerous tests and consultations I can conclude that these are structural limitations of the model, and not a defect in use.Conclusion:Despite the smart features and pleasant aesthetics, the LG DB365TXS dishwasher does not guarantee the minimum performance expected for an appliance of this range. The long times, poor efficiency and the need for frequent interventions make its daily use not very advantageous.
Comments (Original): [ Non compratela ! ] || ---------------- || Utilizzo questa lavastoviglie da poco più di un anno: si tratta del modello LG DB365TXS, da incasso, prodotto in Corea, con dimensioni standard (598 x 815 x 554 mm) e assorbimento energetico compreso tra 1600 e 1800 W (IPX2).Il design e l’interfaccia sono curati, e l’apparecchio è dotato di numerose funzionalità digitali, compresa la connettività tramite LG ThinQ. Tuttavia, le prestazioni nelle due funzioni principali – lavaggio e asciugatura – risultano al di sotto delle aspettative.I cicli standard hanno una durata molto lunga, ma l’efficacia del lavaggio è spesso insoddisfacente: stoviglie ancora sporche o con residui, anche dopo cicli completi. L’asciugatura è debole, soprattutto con stoviglie in plastica o in vetro leggero.Criticità aggiuntiva: la necessità di manutenzioni frequenti, mediamente ogni 8–10 lavaggi (pulizia filtri, bracci irroratori, controlli sullo scarico), il che ne compromette la praticità.All’inizio ho ipotizzato un errore nell’uso o nella configurazione dei programmi, ma dopo numerose prove e consultazioni posso concludere che si tratta di limiti strutturali del modello, e non di un difetto d’uso.Conclusione:Nonostante le funzionalità smart e l’estetica gradevole, la lavastoviglie LG DB365TXS non garantisce le performance minime attese per un elettrodomestico di questa fascia. I tempi lunghi, la scarsa efficacia e la necessità di interventi frequenti rendono poco vantaggioso il suo utilizzo quotidiano.

Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 review ] || ---------------- || The things I like most about the Bosch dishwasher is one how clean the dishes come out. Two, how many dishes you can fit since you have options to have times that are very close to each other. And three how super quiet it is. On the negative side my biggest complaint is that the angles for the ties are funny because the dishes will fall over if you don't have something else to support it. Second there isn't any place for large odd shaped dishes, like big balls, so you have to play some over the top of a large area taking up lots of space. And three since this dishwasher doesn't have any way to remove moisture the dishes come out very wet. I have found that I need to open the dishwasher to vent it for a while to let some of this moisture to evaporate. The benefit of that is that you don't have a heating element that melts plastic in the bottom, which is good. All in all, I really like my dishwasher, and will hope that it does have the reputation of being very reliable, which I don't know yet. And I have adapted somewhat to the uniqueness of some of these features.

Comments (English): [ I waited and waited and finally bought it ] || ---------------- || It's a family of 4. On weekends, we eat at home and when we come back, it's dishwashing hell. It's been 10 years since we got married. I really hate doing dishes. I didn't know when I didn't have it, but now that I do, I wonder why I bought it now! It's so convenient~ I bought it for 14 people, but when I tried to put it in the dishwasher after dinner, it was so full. The technician came alone, reinforced the shelves, and installed it neatly, so I'm satisfied! I paid the additional amount separately, but this dishwasher is completely satisfactory~! It's a dishwashing liberation. Of course, you have to wash it first, but it's a kitchen appliance that reduces the work of housewives because it's so convenient! This product doesn't have a hot air function, but I bought it because I thought it wasn't necessary! Buy it when there's a hot deal. And if you buy a 25-year-old dishwasher, it's a grade 1, so when I ran the regular course. It took about 4 hours and 00 minutes. I wondered if it was right for it to take this long when I ran it for the first time, but the LG technician also told me that it was a grade 1 product because it took over 4 hours and used the least amount of electricity to wash it. But. If you use the regular course, the moisture doesn't dry even in the morning! After using it for a few days, I'm satisfied with the automatic or 1-hour course because the moisture completely dries even in the morning. Please refer to it before purchasing~! I'm still very satisfied, so I recommend it.

The advantages of LG were the soaking function, high-pressure washing, high-temperature drying, and water softening function. Could it be detergent residue or salt from the softening process? If it's salt from the softening process, is it because there's too much salt? I still don't know what it is and I'm feeling uneasy. When I bought the dishwasher, I watched a lot of YouTube reviews, but what kind of dishwasher is that if you don't wash it first, the rice cakes and everything won't fall off at all. Anyone who has used a dishwasher in a place like the US knows that no matter how you throw everything in it, it comes out incredibly clean. My LG air conditioner broke down after 2 years, and it seems they only do promotional things. I was fooled by the advertisement and ended up turning my back on it, thinking, "That's what I expected." Sentence (English): I really thought a lot about whether to go with SK or LG.
Comments (English): [ It's kind of convenient ] || ---------------- || I don't know how many YouTube searches I did to buy a dishwasher. Since I'll be using it for a long time once I buy it, I read reviews very carefully. I really thought a lot about whether to go with SK or LG. I saw other brands get wet and flow to the sides, so I thought that was a chronic problem of that brand, and I decided to go with LG. The advantages of LG were the soaking function, high-pressure washing, high-temperature drying, and water softening function. Today, I used it without the water softening function, and I wiped all the food on the plates for the first time. The pots, plates, lids, etc. that I put in the bottom were cleaned very well, but the rice in the middle layer was dried and not peeled off, and the spoons were clean, but the dried food on the cooking utensils was not peeled off. And since it didn't have the water softening function, there were water stains. Anyway, it's so convenient that I don't have to stand and wash dishes for 30 minutes. That alone makes me think I made a good purchase. Next time, I'll arrange the dishes better and be thorough! ^^ I worried a lot about the color, so I'm uploading this for reference~ Additional) Ah, I saw that the newer models have a frying pan hanger, but this one doesn't. Is it because it's an old model? And after using it a few times, this white residue remains. Other regular dishes are transparent or white, so it doesn't show well, but it shows clearly on the frying pan. Judging from the fact that it washes easily with water, I don't think it's limestone. Could it be detergent residue or salt from the softening process? If it's salt from the softening process, is it because there's too much salt? I still don't know what it is and I'm feeling uneasy. I've filed an AS request, but I'll write down the reason once it's resolved! Additional) After using it for a little over a year, the LCD keeps blinking and making a closing sound as if it's not closing properly, so I contacted the AS center and they said the free AS period was over and that I would have to pay for repairs. For now, since it only happens occasionally, I just used it. After exactly 2 years, the LCD completely went out. It's not even a cheap one that costs a few pennies, but the repair costs are enormous. When I bought the dishwasher, I watched a lot of YouTube reviews, but what kind of dishwasher is that if you don't wash it first, the rice cakes and everything won't fall off at all. Anyone who has used a dishwasher in a place like the US knows that no matter how you throw everything in it, it comes out incredibly clean. My LG air conditioner broke down after 2 years, and it seems they only do promotional things. I was fooled by the advertisement and ended up turning my back on it, thinking, "That's what I expected." No, my S company product has never broken down, but when I bought a house this time, I bought everything from LG, and now the washing machine, dishwasher, and air conditioner are all broken. This is so frustrating! I'm so angry!
